title: SHAB heats up the dance floor with "Dirty (Remixes)"
htmlContent: Persian pop queen and international sensation SHAB tears into one of her most seductive yet in-your-face tracks, "Dirty (remix)." Best known for her classic house anthems, irresistible charisma, and unwavering commitment to heart-filled songwriting, the Choose Love Ambassador doesn't hold back on the dancefloor anthems with this remix anthology. Fresh from the success of its critically lauded second LP, ONE SUITCASE, SHAB is not one to rest on her laurels. She's doubling down. Her original track, "Dirty," builds on the momentum after the EP hit #1 on iTunes, #2 on Apple Music, and #48 on Spotify. She is back for a fresh face with this five-track remix EP.  Grammy-nominated Audé Cutmore, SHOSH, ManyFew x Wilson, and Beyond Chicago breathe new life into the tune. They each put their sonic stamp on SHAB's sultry anthem, and the results are electrifying. https://open.spotify.com/track/1MC7K3S3ts56aoQuhx01cL?si=Z90oPzeaSdmbzr_tOkXmHA The collection starts with Dave Audé at the helm, serving up a classic club banger: All big-room sheen and hands-in-the-air power. Cutmore speeds it up from there, but a glittering house groove gives his remix an intimate and cinematic dimension. ManyFew x Wilson offers a tropical-tinged remix, heavy on shimmer and soaked in sunset vibes and luscious basslines, while SHOSH leads us into UK garage territory, dirty in all the best ways. Rounding out the selections, Beyond Chicago's remix finds a sweet spot between underground grit and mainstream finesse. But what makes it all click is SHAB herself. Her voice, part velvet, part fire, sails through every drop and breakdown with fierce, feminine authority. No one knows who owns this track, whether she's whispering in your ear or belting out a chorus. "Dirty (remix)" isn't simply a nod to sonic diversity; it's evidence of SHAB's global reach and genre-grossing vision. From the dance-floor to the tinny in-ear speakers, it's a tantalizing ride that properly makes the case this ex-refugee turned international pop megastar isn't here to play, and she's here to rule. So go ahead. Get a little dirty. SHAB's already there, and she's dancing in stilettos.
excerpt: SHAB's "Dirty (Remixes)" energizes the dance floor with dynamic beats and fresh remixes, making it a must-listen for dance music enthusiasts.
